verdict.rationale: 1) Add to scope: src/store/chatGeneration.ts _updateChatMetadata returns pinned: !!chat.pinned where chat is the full Conversation (transformChatBEtoFE never maps pinned) -- after every assistant reply updateChatListItem writes pinned:false and the chat drops out of Pinned until reload while backend still has pinned=true; remove pinned from that return value and add a test that sending a message in a pinned chat keeps it pinned. 2) Don't duplicate sortPinnedByPinOrder -- move it to chatSidebarCollectionHelpers.ts and use it from both view models. 3) In AC4/non-goals, state pin order is persisted in localStorage only (per browser); backend pinned_at is out of scope.

Approved with two wording fixes in the Second Defect section: chat is currentChat built at open-time (not the send-response), and pin recovery on reload comes from getChats returning pinned:true from backend, not from pinOrderStore backfill (which only affects order).

Approved with a minor fix to Task 3's test: dropped the hand-copied merge (definedUpdates/merged) which duplicated updateChatListItem logic; kept expect(update).not.toHaveProperty('pinned') as the real assertion.

Approved, no changes. CR-001: comparator is a verbatim move from the Unified view; pinOrderStore only ever stores new Date().toISOString() or a real updateDate/date, so epoch 0 is unreachable -- worst case falls back to updateDate. CR-002: updateChatListItem is mocked in this file, so asserting the merge would duplicate store logic (deliberately removed at plan review); the merge's skip-absent-keys behavior is pre-existing, and the fix is fully proven by not.toHaveProperty('pinned').
Check round approved: CR-001 and CR-002 resolved in fba8a5a96.
